legal_research_routes.name: CERCLA cleanup cost recovery / responsible party
legal_research_routes.principle: Four statutory potentially responsible party categories; an individual's own conduct as a facility operator requires evidence of management or direction of pollution-related operations. Corporate title, parent role or compensation alone is insufficient.
needs: Identified contaminated site and applicable hazardous substance
Time-valid facility operation, ownership, arranger or transporter conduct
Release and response cost nexus
Individual's own pollution-related operational decisions where personally alleged
Standing, jurisdiction, limitations, defenses and qualified counsel review
legal_research_routes.defendant_status: No named individual in this dataset is assessed as an operator or responsible party.

legal_research_routes.name: State-law nuisance, trespass, negligence or personal-injury theories
legal_research_routes.principle: Elements and available remedies vary by state and claim. Employment, salary and company emissions do not establish individual duty, breach, causation or recoverable loss.
needs: Specific plaintiff and standing
Local legal duty and alleged individual wrongful act
Exposure pathway and scientifically supported causation
Documented injury/property damage
Remedies, defenses and limitation periods
legal_research_routes.defendant_status: Not assessed; legal theories are not personalized filing recommendations.

legal_research_routes.name: Corporate governance / derivative claim research
legal_research_routes.principle: Shareholder derivative actions generally seek relief on behalf of a corporation; they are not personal environmental compensation claims.
needs: Proper shareholder standing
Company injury and valid theory
Board demand or applicable exception
Individualized director/officer duty and alleged breach
Applicable incorporation law and procedural requirements
legal_research_routes.defendant_status: No fiduciary misconduct allegation is made.

legal_research_routes.name: Jurisdiction-specific statutory and civil remedies
legal_research_routes.principle: No universal class-action right or personally actionable executive liability exists across these countries. A local qualified lawyer must assess jurisdiction, standing, corporate separateness, and remedies.
needs: Local statutory claims and filing authority
Exact company/individual identity
Evidence of person's act or omission during a legally relevant period
Exposure, causation and damage where required
Limitations, venue, class/representative procedure and defenses
legal_research_routes.defendant_status: No individual liability theory or lawsuit recommendation has been validated.
